description: This file contains Perl code that generates assembly routines for cryptographic operations, specifically AES-GCM-SIV encryption and decryption, including key schedule, message encryption, and related functions for both 128-bit and 256-bit key variants, with support for multiple parallel blocks.

methods.name: gfmul
methods.description: Performs carry-less multiplication in GF(2^128) used in GHASH/Polyval.

methods.name: aesgcmsiv_htable_init
methods.description: Initializes a table of powers of H for GHASH/Polyval.

methods.name: aesgcmsiv_htable6_init
methods.description: Initializes a 6-entry table of powers of H for GHASH/Polyval.

methods.name: aesgcmsiv_htable_polyval
methods.description: Performs GHASH/Polyval calculation using a table of powers of H.

methods.name: aes128gcmsiv_kdf
methods.description: Key Derivation Function for AES-GCM-SIV using a nonce.

methods.name: aes128gcmsiv_enc_msg_x4
methods.description: Encrypts message in 4 blocks in parallel using AES-GCM-SIV.

methods.name: aes128gcmsiv_enc_msg_x8
methods.description: Encrypts message in 8 blocks in parallel using AES-GCM-SIV.

methods.name: aesgcmsiv_dec
methods.description: Decrypts data using AES-GCM-SIV, supporting 128 and 256-bit keys.

methods.name: aes128gcmsiv_ecb_enc_block
methods.description: Encrypts a single 128-bit block with AES-ECB.

methods.name: aes256gcmsiv_ecb_enc_block
methods.description: Encrypts a single 128-bit block with AES-ECB for 256-bit key.

methods.name: aes256gcmsiv_enc_msg_x4
methods.description: Encrypts message in 4 blocks in parallel with AES-GCM-SIV for 256-bit key.

methods.name: aes256gcmsiv_enc_msg_x8
methods.description: Encrypts message in 8 blocks in parallel with AES-GCM-SIV for 256-bit key.
